title: Pop out v4
brief: Your whole closet is already in your camera roll; Curate pulls it out. For US 18–34s who have never heard of Curate. Pop out re-cut the header way (the founder's approved App Store header film): her three photos on a tonal ground give up her camel coat, denim jacket and scarf, one a beat; the camera glides back and they are three of thirty in her camera roll; the phone fades up with the real build-284 scan, her photos sorted out of her roll, her items found; the camera pushes in on the landing, "Added 14 wardrobe items from 7 photos"; the pan through the light to the lockup and "On the App Store"; her photos glide back in (a loop).
hook: 0–2 s: her three photos; on the drop the camel coat lifts out of her DUMBO photo, then the denim jacket and the scarf out of the others, one a beat; at 0.92 s "Your closet is already in your camera roll."
disclosures: Emma is an AI-generated persona and her photos are AI-generated: turn on the platform AI label (TikTok "AI-generated content", Meta "AI info", YouTube "altered or synthetic content").

The app footage is real Curate 1.5.1 (build 284) at real speed, recorded on a simulator with Emma's photos and wardrobe and the server's answers faked (the scan's "14 items from 7 photos" is the test build's count, not a live account's).
